visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man is seen from a high angle getting ice from a stainless steel Frigidaire refrigerator in a kitchen with wooden flooring. (2) The scene shifts to the man wearing a white North Face t-shirt and glasses, standing at a kitchen counter. He is weighing white non-dairy creamer powder on a small orange digital scale next to a gaming laptop. (3) A close-up shot shows a large metal bowl where dark, steaming tea is being strained from a pot using a mesh strainer. (4) The man speaks directly to the camera in the kitchen, explaining the ratio of tea to creamer. Behind him are various kitchen items and a bright window. (5) He pours a bowl of white powder back into its bag, then a meme overlay appears with his face photoshopped onto a SWAT team member's body kicking down a door. (6) A thermometer is inserted into the hot tea, showing a temperature around 55 degrees Celsius. (7) The man pours a large bowl of milk powder into the metal bowl of tea and stirs it vigorously with a large metal ladle until it becomes a creamy brown color. (8) He pours the mixture into a metal shaker, attempts to shake it, but flinches as the shaker is too hot to hold. (9) He pours the milk tea into a glass and takes a sip, nodding in approval before preparing another batch with a small bowl of brown sugar. (10) The man drinks from a silver can while laughing hysterically, looking upwards with an exaggerated expression of joy.
